invisalign.title: Invisalign® Clear Aligners
invisalign.summary: Invisalign® clear aligners are virtually invisible, removable trays custom-made using 3D iTero® intraoral scanning to straighten teeth comfortably without metal wires or brackets.
benefits: Removable for effortless eating and brushing
Fewer clinic visits than metal braces
invisalign.suitable_for: Teens and adults with crowded teeth, gaps, overbite, or underbite looking for discreet alignment.

implants.title: Dental Implants
implants.summary: Dental implants are permanent, natural-feeling titanium root replacements anchored into the jawbone, capped with handcrafted porcelain crowns for lifetime chewing strength and smile aesthetics.
benefits: Prevents jawbone loss and preserves facial structure
Seamless aesthetic match with surrounding teeth

smile_makeover.title: Full Smile Makeover
smile_makeover.summary: A comprehensive smile makeover combines digital smile design, porcelain veneers, laser whitening, and aligners to reconstruct facial and dental symmetry tailored to your unique features.
benefits: Holistic transformation of shape, alignment, and color

veneers.title: Porcelain Veneers
veneers.summary: Porcelain veneers are ultra-thin, handcrafted ceramic shells permanently bonded to the front surface of teeth to correct deep stains, chips, gaps, or irregular shapes.

whitening.title: Laser Teeth Whitening
whitening.summary: Our in-office laser teeth whitening uses advanced LED-activated gel to brighten yellowed or discolored teeth up to 8 shades lighter in just 45 minutes.
benefits: Up to 8 shades whiter in 45 minutes

root_canal.title: Painless Root Canal Treatment
root_canal.summary: Our single-visit rotary endodontics eliminates nerve infection 100% painlessly using micro-anesthesia, preserving your natural tooth.
benefits: Completed in a single comfortable visit

kids_dentistry.title: Pediatric & Kids Dentistry
kids_dentistry.summary: Gentle, stress-free dental care for children including preventive sealants, cavity fillings, space maintainers, and gentle habit management in a playful environment.

doctors.summary: LARA Smiles features a team of accredited dental specialists including Prosthodontists, Endodontists, Implantologists, and Certified Invisalign® Diamond Providers.
doctors.lead_specialist: Dr. Lara & Team of Senior Dental Surgeons with over 12+ years of clinical excellence across 15,000+ smile transformations.

Invisalign® clear aligners are virtually invisible, removable trays designed to straighten your teeth comfortably without metal brackets. As certified Invisalign® Diamond Providers, we offer 3D iTero® digital smile simulations!
Dental implants are permanent, natural-feeling titanium root replacements anchored into the jawbone. They restore 100% chewing strength and prevent jawbone loss.
A Smile Makeover combines 3D digital facial planning, porcelain veneers, laser whitening, and aligners to craft your ideal, confident smile tailored to your facial symmetry.
Our 45-minute Laser Teeth Whitening brightens your teeth up to 8 shades lighter using LED-activated, enamel-safe, anti-sensitivity gels!
Our Painless Root Canal Treatment utilizes single-visit rotary endodontics and gentle micro-anesthesia to save your natural tooth with 0% pain.
Porcelain Veneers are handcrafted ceramic shells bonded to the front of your teeth to correct discoloration, chips, gaps, or minor misalignment.
Our clinical team consists of accredited dental surgeons, endodontists, prosthodontists, implantologists, and certified Invisalign® Diamond Providers committed to compassionate, world-class care.
